title: 🏛️ RBI Principle-Based Natural Calamity Loan Resolution Framework Effective April 2026
summary: RBI relaxed proposed risk-weight norms for NBFC infrastructure exposures: 75% risk weight assigned at 2% repayment threshold (cut from 5%), and 50% risk weight at 5% repayment threshold (cut from 10%). Takes effect April 1, 2026.

blocks.content: **Overview**: RBI relaxed proposed risk-weight norms for NBFC infrastructure exposures: 75% risk weight assigned at 2% repayment threshold (cut from 5%), and 50% risk weight at 5% repayment threshold (cut from 10%). Takes effect April 1, 2026.

items: **RBI Eases Infrastructure Lending Risk-Weight Framework for NBFCs** (Page 16): RBI relaxed proposed risk-weight norms for NBFC infrastructure exposures: 75% risk weight assigned at 2% repayment threshold (cut from 5%), and 50% risk weight at 5% repayment threshold (cut from 10%). Takes effect April 1, 2026.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Disaster Relief Lending & Credit Restructuring. Provides operational flexibility for banks to reschedule standard/SMA-0 loans impacted by natural disasters based on SLBC/DCC inputs.
